  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeGeneral, RecognizeAdvanced
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET

  Interface: sdk

  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html

  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk

  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS

  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, enqueue_and_parse
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import documentai
import io
import os

def extract_table_structure(file_path, project_id, location, processor_id):
    os.environ["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"] = "path/to/credentials.json"
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    with io.open(file_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()

    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=image_content, mime_type="application/pdf")
    name = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}"
    document = client.process_document(name=name, raw_document=raw_document)

    tables = []
    for page in document.pages:
        for table in page.tables:
            table_data = []
            for row in table.header_rows:
                table_data.append([cell.text for cell in row.cells])
            for row in table.rows:
                table_data.append([cell.text for cell in row.cells])
            tables.append(table_data)

    return tables
```
